newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares slip in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares slip in quiet trade.

text.p: Shares on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) dipped in quiet trading last week with Namibia Breweries (NamBrew) and Gold Fields of Namibia topping the loser board, dealers said.
NamBrew fell to N$2.45 after trading at N$2.58 earlier in the week and Gold Fields fell to a new low of N$1.30.
Barlow saw the biggest value trade after shares worth N$1.4 million changed hands and CIC Holdings was the volume leader of the week with 198,500 shares traded in a single deal.

A total of 365,300 shares worth N$2.5 million traded on the week. The NSE overall index slipped to close at 244.81 from the previous week's close of 246.96. The NSE local index finished softer at 148.49 from 150.05 before.
